mapper.select: SELECT r.review_id, r.content, r.rate, r.create_date, m.musical_id, m.title AS title, m.image AS image, u.user_id, u.nickname AS nickname, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM like_review lr WHERE lr.review_id = r.review_id ) AS like_count FROM review r JOIN musical m ON r.musical_id = m.musical_id JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}

SELECT r.review_id, r.content, r.rate, r.create_date, m.title AS title, m.image AS image, u.user_id, u.nickname AS nickname, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM like_review lr WHERE lr.review_id = r.review_id ) AS like_count FROM review r JOIN musical m ON r.musical_id = m.musical_id JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.review_id DESC

SELECT r.review_id, r.content, r.rate, r.create_date, m.musical_id, m.title AS title, m.image AS image, u.user_id, u.nickname AS nickname, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM like_review lr WHERE lr.review_id = r.review_id ) AS like_count FROM review r JOIN musical m ON r.musical_id = m.musical_id JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY like_count DESC limit 4;

SELECT r.review_id, r.content, r.rate, r.create_date, m.musical_id, m.title AS title, m.image AS image, u.user_id, u.nickname AS nickname, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM like_review lr WHERE lr.review_id = r.review_id ) AS like_count FROM review r JOIN musical m ON r.musical_id = m.musical_id JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE m.musical_id = #{musicalId} ORDER BY r.review_id DESC
SELECT ROUND(AVG(rate), 1) FROM review WHERE user_id = #{userId};

SELECT n.rate, COUNT(r.review_id) AS count FROM ( SELECT 1 AS rate UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 ) n LEFT JOIN review r ON r.rate = n.rate AND r.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY n.rate ORDER BY n.rate;
